name: Air Jordan 11 Retro 'Bred' 2019
story_html: The Air Jordan 11 Retro 'Bred' 2019 brings back an original colorway initially debuted in 1995. The Tinker Hatfield-designed silhouette features Chicago Bulls colors, with black mesh on the upper sitting atop shiny black patent leather. A white midsole melds nicely with a translucent Varsity Red outsole, and is the same colorway that Michael Jordan wore during the 1996 NBA championship playoff run. This retro was distributed in December 2019 with OG detailing, including high-cut patent leather, signature Jumpman branding and MJ's number 23 stamped on the heel.
